update.title: OT-02 death and Sheol: Ch 2 death sections registered and corrected
update.strand: life and death (M25), OT-02 Q1 What is death?
update.researcher_instruction: "a) ensure the claim register is complete for the reading of these verses. b) ensure that the narrative support the claims c) ensure that the narrative does not violate the truth." (2026-10-14, after: "a) narratives with no basis for the claims - these should be removed from the narrative ... b) a tendency to make verses fit a particular narrative ... c) verses are dropped or set aside if the do not fit into the narrative")
update.method: R0 for the Ch 2 sections What death is, Going down to Sheol (new), Sleep and waking, Soul, spirit and heart at death, Delivered from death and After death; the 55 Sheol/Hades/sleep verses that were in neither the narrative nor the register read in their passages and woven. Removed: 'Sheol is the grave, the realm of the dead' (no verse). Corrected: the dead 'silent and gone' stated as one side only and framed 'from this side of death'; Luke 16:22 cited without the rich man in Hades (16:23-31); Isa 5:14 set aside as 'one witness is enough'; the 15-verse count shown without its verses (Psa 86:13, Pro 23:14 counted, never shown); 'one picture for death' softened to 'often'.
update.claims_changed_note: 33 narrative claims added with sources and tellings; 3-9 corrected (its unsupported 'Sheol here is death and the grave, not a destination distinct from the spirit's' removed); 3-7, 3-9, 3-10, 3-13, 6-2, 2-3, 2-15 linked to the passages that tell them.
update.not_woven_note: 15 of the 70 uncovered verses are data only: sleep in its ordinary sense (Gen 2:21; 41:5; Judg 16:14; Psa 4:8; Pro 4:16; Isa 5:27; Eze 34:25; Luk 22:45; Act 12:6), H3462 in another sense (Lev 13:11 chronic; 26:10 long kept), Sheol as a measure only (Isa 57:9), Jer 51:57 (same oracle as 51:39, cited), 1Co 7:39 and 11:30 (sleep rendered 'dies', 'died'; no inner-being bearing). Isa 7:11 and Job 11:8 are now cited. The 1,010 die/death-only verses were read in unit 2 and not re-checked.
update.structure_change: Ch 2 gains the section 'Going down to Sheol' before 'Sleep and waking'.
update.structure_reason: The Sheol verses had no home; read in their passages they speak of where Sheol lies, who goes down, how, and God and Sheol.
update.quote_note: narrative-quote-check-v1-20261014.py on the lines v22 adds to v21; the one non-match is the section title 'Soul, spirit and heart at death'.
update.notes: Researcher findings recorded in CLAUDE.md and memory feedback_claims_register_keeps_narrative_honest.

edit.text: Most of these verses speak of the soul delivered or brought up from Sheol: a living person rescued from death. Corrected 2026-10-04 (#1950): of 15 soul-delivered verses, 12 are rescue from dying; Psa 49:15 (set against the death of all, 49:10) and Psa 16:10 (as Act 2:27, 31 read it) look beyond death; Psa 89:48 says no one can. The verdict holds: no verse gives soul and spirit different destinations. The verses that name Sheol or Hades speak of the soul and never of the spirit. Ecc 3:21 leaves the spirit's destination open ("Who knows?"). The "different destinations" argument, which the original called "the most compelling evidence", does not hold (G §16.4; dep §3.9)
edit.note: OT-02, 2026-10-14: removed 'Sheol here is death and the grave, not a destination distinct from the spirit's' (no verse states it); the spirit sentence states what the 74 Sheol/Hades verses show.
